# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: UAE 1970 lifecycle — scripted effects.
## COLDWAR | UAE 1970. Generated by tools/uae_1970/compile.py.
COLDWAR_UAE_initialise = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_start_gdp_frozen } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_start_gdp = 0.686 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_start_gdp_frozen
		}

		COLDWAR_UAE_politics_init = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_init_british = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_UAE_daily_update = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes }
		COLDWAR_UAE_politics_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_init_british = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_british_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_retry_pending_focuses = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}
